method: Mascot rebuilt from editable SVG geometry. Three activity arcs share a 90-unit-radius circle and retain source colors and stroke width. Their starts are shortened to fit the user-requested Iconsax Bold icons, with round ends.
checks: No image elements or base64 content in SVG
Visual comparison in browser at reference size
Activity entry and day selection work
Chat sends and new chat returns mascot
Menu, profile and tab switching work
npm run check: eight scale tests and build passed
limitations: Static demonstration activity curves; no live tracking backend

icons.placement: Moved 4 degrees clockwise toward their matching arcs, with larger clearance to the neighboring arc.

arcSpacing: Trailing ends extended 4 degrees to reduce gaps; icons stay closer to matching arcs.

arcGeometry.method: Identical SVG d path, rotated by 0, 120 and 240 degrees
